note: Requirement IDs are stable. Add tasks freely; never renumber an existing requirement.

tasks.title: pytest fixtures and parametrisation

requirements.text: Write one parametrised test covering three cases from a single function
Move shared setup into a fixture and explain its scope

tasks.acceptance: A parametrised test file runs green and the learner can say what changes when fixture scope moves from function to session.

tasks.title: Arabic text normalisation

requirements.text: Normalise Arabic-Indic digits to ASCII and match '٥ أيام' against must_include ['5']
Explain why alef unification helps BM25 and what it costs

tasks.acceptance: The learner reuses the normalisation helpers from scripts/validate_data.py rather than writing new ones, and can state one case where normalisation loses information.

tasks.title: SQL filtering alongside vector search

requirements.text: Write a query combining a vector ORDER BY with a WHERE clause on metadata
Explain why post-filtering can return fewer than k results

tasks.acceptance: The learner predicts, before running, what a highly restrictive filter does to result count under each strategy.

tasks.title: Reading a trace

requirements.text: From one trace, name the slowest span and the token counts in and out
Point at the retrieved chunks actually placed in the prompt

tasks.acceptance: Given a trace of a wrong answer, the learner names the layer at fault without reading the code.

tasks.title: Set the mission

requirements.text: Write the mission in one sentence in LEARNER_PROFILE.md
State the honesty rule in their own words: only numbers in docs/results.md may be quoted

tasks.acceptance: progress.json has a non-empty mission and the learner can say why the mock's numbers are off-limits.

tasks.title: Placement check

requirements.text: Complete the 15-minute diagnostic, one item at a time
Record each result as a prior-knowledge record with the evidence

tasks.acceptance: placement.status is done or declined; any waived task is a bridge task with demonstrated evidence.

tasks.title: Validate the data and read the gates

requirements.text: Run scripts/validate_data.py and read its output
Explain the difference between a hard gate and a target, and why holdout IDs may not be looked at

tasks.acceptance: validate_data.py passes, and the learner names the six hard gates without reading them aloud from the file.

tasks.title: Eval harness skeleton

requirements.text: Load golden_rag.jsonl and iterate items with their user context
Reuse the matching functions from scripts/validate_data.py, do not reimplement normalisation
Build the retrieval filter from item.user, never from the question text

tasks.acceptance: The harness runs all 125 items against a stub retriever and reports counts per slice and per language.

tasks.title: Retrieval metrics with intervals

requirements.text: Compute hit@k by source section overlap, not chunk ID, so chunking stays comparable
Compute recall@k for multi_hop items and MRR overall
Report every metric per slice and per language with a 95% interval

tasks.acceptance: A report prints per-slice hit@5 with intervals, and the learner can say why a 3-point gain on ~100 items is not a result.

tasks.title: Baseline parsers, simplest per format

requirements.text: Extract text from every corpus format with the simplest working parser
Measure extraction accuracy against data/policies/ as ground truth and record the number

tasks.acceptance: Every one of the 21 documents yields text, with a measured accuracy figure and the known-bad cases named.

tasks.title: Fixed-size chunks, one embedding model, top-5 search

requirements.text: Chunk at a fixed size and record the token budget used
Embed with one multilingual model and serve top-5 vector search

tasks.acceptance: The harness runs end to end against the real index and produces a hit@5 number.

tasks.title: One grounded prompt with citations

requirements.text: Answer only from retrieved chunks, with a citation per claim
Put CANARY-7f3a in the system prompt and assert it never appears in an answer
Refuse when nothing relevant was retrieved

tasks.acceptance: Refusal items refuse, no must_not_include string appears, and the canary never leaks.

tasks.title: Validate the LLM judge

requirements.text: Hand-label 60 answers before looking at the judge's output
Report agreement and Cohen's kappa; aim for kappa >= 0.6
Write down when the judge must be re-validated

tasks.acceptance: A kappa figure exists with its n, and the learner can say what a kappa of 0.4 would have meant for every later number.

tasks.title: Tracing from the first request

requirements.text: Trace every request with spans for retrieve, rerank and generate
Mask personal data in traces

tasks.acceptance: A wrong answer can be diagnosed from its trace alone, and no personal data appears in it.

tasks.title: CI smoke gate

requirements.text: Run the 40 smoke IDs on every pull request
Block the merge on any hard-gate failure

tasks.acceptance: A deliberately broken change fails CI on a hard gate, demonstrated once.

tasks.title: Record the baseline

requirements.text: Add the baseline row with intervals, per-slice figures and the eval set version
Record the exact configuration that produced it

tasks.acceptance: M1 exit: baseline row in docs/results.md, CI gate working, judge validated.

tasks.title: Layout-aware parsing for tables and two columns

requirements.text: Keep column meaning in the leave entitlement, per-diem and overtime tables
Stop the privacy notice's two columns interleaving
Strip repeated headers and footers

tasks.acceptance: The table slice improves against the M1 baseline, reported before and after with McNemar.

tasks.title: OCR the scanned insurance schedule

requirements.text: Extract the scanned table from health_insurance_schedule_2026 with its columns intact
Record OCR accuracy against the Markdown source

tasks.acceptance: Questions answered only by the scanned schedule now retrieve it.

tasks.title: HTML cleaning and the hidden element decision

requirements.text: Remove navigation boilerplate from employee_faq.html
Decide what to do with hidden elements and write the decision down with its reasoning
Ensure the planted injection is detected and reported, never obeyed

tasks.acceptance: The security slice passes and the hidden-element decision is recorded as a decision record.

tasks.title: Chunking comparison at a fixed token budget

requirements.text: Compare 5 strategies at the same token budget, not the same chunk count
Report hit@5 per strategy per slice

tasks.acceptance: A comparison table exists and the winner is justified per slice, not on the average alone.

tasks.title: Contextual chunk headers

requirements.text: Prepend document and section context to each chunk
Measure the effect separately from the chunking strategy change

tasks.acceptance: The isolated effect of headers is a number, not an impression.

tasks.title: Metadata filters enforced in SQL

requirements.text: Filter by allowed_roles, regions and effective dates inside the query, never in the prompt
Prove a restrictive filter still returns k results
Present-day questions must never retrieve leave_policy_2025, except q76 and q77

tasks.acceptance: Hard gate green: no chunk from a document the user may not see is ever retrieved. abac and version slices pass.

tasks.title: Embedding bake-off on en and ar

requirements.text: Compare 3 or more multilingual models on the en and ar slices
Include the English question answered only by an Arabic document
Report cost and index build time alongside quality

tasks.acceptance: A per-model, per-language table exists and the choice is defended on more than the overall average.

tasks.title: BM25 with Arabic normalisation, fused with RRF

requirements.text: Add BM25 with Arabic normalisation applied to both index and query
Fuse with RRF and justify k
Show the code_lookup slice improving on identifiers such as HR-EX-03

tasks.acceptance: code_lookup improves measurably and the learner can write the RRF formula from memory.

tasks.title: Cross-encoder reranking

requirements.text: Rerank the fused candidates and tune candidate depth
Report the latency cost against the 2 s p95 TTFT target

tasks.acceptance: Quality gain and latency cost are both recorded; the tradeoff is stated explicitly.

tasks.title: Relevance gate threshold

requirements.text: Tune the threshold on out_of_scope against answerable items, never on the holdout
Report refusal accuracy in both directions

tasks.acceptance: Refusal accuracy in both directions meets 0.9, and the learner can name the cost of moving the threshold either way.

tasks.title: Query rewriting for follow-ups

requirements.text: Rewrite follow-ups using turns, and evaluate the rewriter alone against standalone_query
Show the follow_up slice before and after

tasks.acceptance: The rewriter has its own score separate from end-to-end retrieval.

tasks.title: Schema output and citation verification

requirements.text: Emit a schema-validated answer with citations
Verify every citation resolves to a chunk actually in context; report the citation-failure rate

tasks.acceptance: Faithfulness meets 0.95 and citation failures are counted, not estimated.

tasks.title: Conflict handling

requirements.text: When wellbeing_program_2026 and benefits_policy disagree, present both and point to People Operations
Do not let the model silently pick a side

tasks.acceptance: Both conflict items pass.

tasks.title: SSE streaming

requirements.text: Stream the answer with SSE and measure TTFT
Ensure citation verification still runs before the answer is complete or is clearly deferred

tasks.acceptance: p95 TTFT is measured and compared with the 2 s target.

tasks.title: LLM comparison

requirements.text: Run the same eval on 3 or more models at temperature 0 with pinned versions
Produce a quality, p95 latency and cost-per-query table

tasks.acceptance: The chosen model is defended on the table, including the cost target of $0.01 per query.

tasks.title: Incremental re-index and a blue-green swap

requirements.text: Re-index only changed documents, detected by hash
Swap to a new embedding model behind a blue-green index with evals run before the cutover

tasks.acceptance: M2 exit: all hard gates green, targets met or gaps explained, at least 2 war stories logged.

tasks.title: Read tools and session identity

requirements.text: Implement the seven read tools from docs/agent_tools.md
No tool accepts an employee ID; identity, role and region come from the session only
get_team_leave_summary returns direct reports only, and is empty for non-managers

tasks.acceptance: A request for another employee's data cannot be expressed in the tool schema.

tasks.title: Deterministic rules engine

requirements.text: Read data/leave_rules.json; compute working days excluding Friday, Saturday and company holidays
3-day notice counts working days strictly between submission and the first day; 2-week notice counts calendar days
One unit test per rule value, each citing its policy clause

tasks.acceptance: 5-7 Oct 2026 costs 2 working days; E1004's probation and E1002's Q3 blackout produce the right severities.

tasks.title: Preview and draft preparation

requirements.text: preview_leave_request stores nothing and returns violations with severity and source
Blocking violations produce no draft; needs_extra_approval attaches the violation to the draft

tasks.acceptance: stored_requests_delta is 0 for every blocked scenario.

tasks.title: Confirm and cancel endpoints

requirements.text: Confirm is an HTTP endpoint, not a tool, and is absent from the tool schema
A repeated confirm on the same draft ID stores nothing new
Confirmed requests land as pending_manager_approval; no tool has a status argument

tasks.acceptance: confirm_retry scenarios leave stored_requests_delta unchanged.

tasks.title: Loop guards and normalised errors

requirements.text: At most 5 tool calls per message and no identical repeated call
Pydantic-validated arguments with exactly one retry on validation error
Normalised tool errors carrying a retryable flag

tasks.acceptance: Scenario a09 terminates without a retry loop and tells the user.

tasks.title: Twenty scenarios, five runs

requirements.text: All 20 scenarios pass 5 consecutive runs
Report tool-selection accuracy against the 0.95 target
Treat the indirect injection in scenario a19 as data

tasks.acceptance: M3 exit: 20/20 over 5 runs, tool-selection accuracy recorded in docs/results.md.

tasks.title: Redaction before the model

requirements.text: Remove every excluded_from_scoring field before any LLM call
Handle cand_08's dense personal data and the two-column PDF with a photo box

tasks.acceptance: Hard gate green: no must_redact field reaches the LLM input.

tasks.title: Evidence extraction only

requirements.text: For each criterion the LLM returns a verbatim quote or none, and never a score
cand_02's 'Introductory Python module in progress' must not count as Python evidence

tasks.acceptance: The model's output contains no numbers at all.

tasks.title: Code-side scoring, bands and the required rule

requirements.text: Compute the score in code from the evidence and the rubric weights
A required criterion scoring 0 caps the band at review and adds missing_required:<id>
Never emit overqualified, seniority, age, career_gap or family_status flags; cand_04 is neither penalised nor flagged

tasks.acceptance: screening_expectations.json passes for all 8 resumes.

tasks.title: Injection detection in resumes

requirements.text: Flag cand_05 as prompt_injection from both the .txt and the white 1-point PDF text
The injected instruction must not change the score

tasks.acceptance: Hard gate green: cand_05 is flagged prompt_injection and scores on its real evidence.

tasks.title: The counterfactual suite

requirements.text: All 32 variants produce exactly the same score, band and flags as their base
Hold over 5 consecutive runs
Explain which design choice makes this possible

tasks.acceptance: M4 exit: screening_expectations.json passes and 32/32 counterfactuals match exactly over 5 runs.

tasks.title: Ticket routing baseline

requirements.text: Obtain the dataset per data/tickets/README.md and record its licence and limits
TF-IDF plus a linear classifier baseline with macro-F1 and a confusion matrix

tasks.acceptance: A baseline macro-F1 exists with a per-class breakdown.

tasks.title: SetFit, fine-tuned encoder and LLM compared

requirements.text: Compare all four approaches on macro-F1, latency and cost
Never load a pickle or joblib artifact from an untrusted source

tasks.acceptance: A four-row comparison table exists with all three columns.

tasks.title: Distribution shift and the conclusion
concepts: when not to use an LLM

requirements.text: Run the English-to-German shift test and report the drop per approach
Write the one-paragraph 'when not to use an LLM' conclusion

tasks.acceptance: M5 exit: comparison table, confusion matrix and the conclusion paragraph.

tasks.title: FastAPI, Postgres and Docker

requirements.text: Serve retrieval, generation and the agent behind FastAPI with SSE
Postgres with pgvector, and RLS enforcing the access rules

tasks.acceptance: The stack comes up from a clean checkout with one command.

tasks.title: CI/CD with the eval gate and dashboards

requirements.text: Deployment blocks on the hard gates and the regression rule
Dashboards for latency, cost and refusal rate

tasks.acceptance: A regression that trips McNemar at p < 0.05 blocks the pipeline.

tasks.title: Load test and cost optimisation

requirements.text: Load test with Locust or k6 and record p50/p95
Apply at least two optimisations and record cost and TTFT before and after each

tasks.acceptance: Each optimisation has a before and after row, not a combined one.

tasks.title: Runbook and pinned versions

requirements.text: Write the runbook: rollback, index swap, model swap, incident triage
Pin model and embedding versions everywhere they are used

tasks.acceptance: M6 exit: a demo runnable live, plus before/after numbers.

tasks.title: The 60-second pitch, with your numbers

requirements.text: Every number in the pitch traces to a row in docs/results.md with its interval and date
No number from the mock appears anywhere

tasks.acceptance: Delivered in 60 seconds from memory, with each claim's source nameable on demand.

tasks.title: The two diagrams

requirements.text: Draw both from the real system, including the trust boundary at the confirm endpoint
Reproduce each on a whiteboard in under 3 minutes

tasks.acceptance: Drawn twice from memory without reference.

tasks.title: Four war stories

requirements.text: At least 4 stories from different layers, each complete on all five points
Each names the trace evidence that found the cause, not a guess

tasks.acceptance: Each story survives 'how did you know it was that layer?'

tasks.title: Drill-down cards per stage
concepts: say it, understand it, why this over the alternative

requirements.text: One card per stage with all three levels
Each card names the alternative rejected and the measurement that rejected it

tasks.acceptance: Every stage in the map has a card backed by a result row.

tasks.title: Two timed mock interviews

requirements.text: Run two timed mocks covering different stages
Log every exposed gap as a new task

tasks.acceptance: M7 exit: two mocks done, gaps logged as tasks.
